query:
UPDATE database_syncs
            SET columns = $3,
                detached_columns = $4,
                last_failure = $5,
                last_synced_at = CASE WHEN $5::text IS NULL THEN now() ELSE last_synced_at END,
                due_at = LEAST(due_at, now() + make_interval(secs => $6)),
                lease_id = NULL,
                lease_expires_at = NULL
            WHERE id = $1 AND lease_id = $2
